svg.desc: Zambia Substations Package LOCATION Zambia CLIENT Alstom Grid/ZESCO COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2017 20 million USD each DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2017, this GIS/AIS substation project in Kafue and Muzuma, Zambia, was delivered for Alstom Grid and ZESCO, with each substation valued at 20 million USD. The project aimed to enhance grid reliability and expand electricity access in the region. Services included architecture, structural and civil engineering, MEP, and technical support for the development of this critical power infrastructure.
